Mission Description

Profile Synthesis: Calypso Application Support

1. Core Purpose & Scope

Function: Providing production support for the Calypso settlement system within Capital Markets.
Focus Areas: Supporting the Trade Life Cycle, specifically Settlements, Securities and Prime Brokerage.
Environment: High-pressure, global, 24/7 production environments requiring collaboration across multiple time zones (Europe, India, Americas).
2. Profile Segregation

Junior:
Focus: Incident routing, functional queries, and basic troubleshooting.
Core Task: Acting as a Single Point of Contact (SPOC) to resolve or escalate technical/functional issues.
Key Requirement: Basic knowledge of Capital Markets products and strong motivation for support.
Senior:
Focus: Platform stability, complex problem management, and mentoring junior staff.
Core Task: Proactive monitoring, driving "Production Excellence," and contributing to AI/automation initiatives.
Key Requirement: 7–8 years of deep domain expertise and advanced technical troubleshooting.
Profile Requirement
3. Technical & Functional Skillsets

Functional: Deep understanding of Back Office functions (Settlement, Accounting, Position Management, STP) and market products (Securities, Bonds, Warrants).
Technical (Senior Level):
OS/DB: Linux/Unix, Oracle, Sybase, MSSQL.
Monitoring: Geneos, Dynatrace, Grafana, Opensearch.
Automation/Scripting: Python, Shell scripting, Autosys.
Frameworks: ITIL (ServiceNow, Jira).
4. Soft Skills & Operational Requirements

Communication: Ability to interact directly with high-stakes stakeholders like Traders and Sales.
Adaptability: High stress resistance and flexibility to work in rotation shifts or bank holidays.
Mindset: Proactive, result-oriented, and focused on automation to minimize manual errors.
